player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.bad_format: Pasin bilong raitim ol tok i no stret. Yusim '[b1 c3]'.
invalid_move.own_piece: Ol i no inap go daun long graun bilong ol yet.
invalid_move.not_knight: Em i no wanpela pasin bilong ol soldia.

game_action.moved: Pleeya {player_id} imuvim peis bilong em from {frm} go long {to}.

outcome.no_pieces: Man {player_id} i no gat wanpela pilai.
outcome.higher_score: Namba bilong ol man i kisim dispela samting.
outcome.move_limit: Ol i no inap mekim moa.
